mapper.select: SELECT cdfi.*, cdf.name formName FROM cat_dynamic_form_instance cdfi INNER JOIN cat_dynamic_form cdf on cdfi.form_id = cdf.id

SELECT cdff.*, cdffi.val value FROM cat_dynamic_form cdf inner join cat_dynamic_form_instance cdfi on cdf.id = cdfi.form_id inner join cat_dynamic_form_field cdff on cdf.id = cdff.form_id and cdfi.version = cdff.version inner join cat_dynamic_form_field_instance cdffi on cdff.id = cdffi.form_field_id and cdfi.id = cdffi.form_instance_id
cdfi.id = #{formInstanceId}
